verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for business software, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Gusto as a hosted service: the Embedded Payroll API on api.gusto.com, a remote MCP server at mcp.api.gusto.com, and Gusto doing the tax and bank-transfer processing itself. The Apache-2.0 gusto-cli is an open-source client for that hosted API, not a self-hostable copy of the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
